blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The tropical depression monitored outside the Philippine area of responsibility (PAR) will enter the country by Thursday morning or afternoon and is expected to enhance the southwest monsoon, according to the state weather bureau on Wednesday. In the 5 a.m. weather forecast of the Philippine Atmospheric, Geophysical, and Astronomical Services Administration (Pagasa), weather specialist Chenel Dominguez said the tropical depression was estimated to be 1,920 kilometers east of Southeastern Luzon as of 3 a.m. It was carrying maximum sustained winds of 55 kilometers per hour (kph) and gustiness of up to 70 kph.
